description: This is a Spring MVC controller class managing product options in an admin web interface, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product options.

classes.name: OptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing product options in the admin interface, handling CRUD operations and listing with pagination.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to list product options, sets up menu, returns view for listing options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to edit a specific product option by ID, fetches data and prepares model.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares product option data for creating or editing, loads existing data if ID provided.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new or existing product option, performs validation, persistence, and returns to detail view.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles POST request for paginated listing of options, returns JSON response with option data.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a specified product option, with authorization check and JSON response.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu context in the model for UI navigation.
